title: Generative AI for Validating Physics Laws
abstract: arXiv:2503.17894v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose generative learner for estimating heterogeneous treatment effects and characterizing the full distribution of causal effects. The learner takes the form of a multi-head feed-forward neural network with three jointly estimated subnetworks, propensity score, baseline outcome, and heterogeneous treatment effects, where the treatment-effect subnetwork parameterizes the conditional quantile function via a compositional architecture in which covariate features and cosine quantile embeddings are combined through element-wise multiplication. This quantile-based formulation recovers the conditional average treatment effect as an integral over quantile treatment effects while additionally characterizing the entire effect distribution. translated_title: 生成式学习器用于验证物理定律
translated_abstract: arXiv:2503.17894v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们提出了一种生成式学习器，用于估计异质性处理效应并刻画因果效应的完整分布。该学习器采用多头前馈神经网络的形式，包含三个联合估计的子网络：倾向得分、基线结果和异质性处理效应。其中，处理效应子网络通过一种组合架构对条件分位数函数进行参数化，该架构将协变量特征与余弦分位数嵌入通过逐元素乘法相结合。这种基于分位数的公式将条件平均处理效应恢复为分位数处理效应的积分，同时额外刻画了整个效应分布。在Neyman-Rubin因果模型的经典假设下，我们证明了所提出的生成式学习器的性能提升在不同实验设计下保持一致，且在频率上具有一致性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分位数组合架构的生成式学习器，能同时估计异质性处理效应和因果效应的完整分布，并在不同实验设计中保持性能优势。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generative learner with a quantile-based compositional architecture that estimates heterogeneous treatment effects and the full causal effect distribution, achieving consistent performance gains across experimental designs.
